Why Port Arthur businesses miss calls

Port Arthur sits on the Sabine-Neches Waterway and is home to one of the largest refineries in the United States. Construction employs nearly 17% of workers, the top share among the Texas cities we cover, and manufacturing over 10%. Median income is lower here, at about $46,000, so small firms must watch costs. Storms such as Harvey in 2017 showed how fast local contractors can be flooded with calls.

Which Port Arthur businesses benefit most?

  • Roofing companies: After a storm, the first company to answer often gets the job.
  • HVAC and contractors: Gulf heat makes AC calls urgent.
  • Law firms: Injury callers can reach intake at any hour.

Can you keep your Port Arthur phone number?

Yes. Port Arthur callers will usually see the 409 area codes, and you can keep the number customers already know. Forward it to the AI for all calls, only after hours, or only when your team does not pick up. We can also set up a new local number. Everything is set up remotely, so you do not need new equipment or a visit to an office.

What to check before you go live

  1. Test real calls: ask awkward questions, not only easy ones, and listen to how it handles them.
  2. Set the rules: decide which calls transfer to a person and which become messages.
  3. Plan your minutes: estimate your busiest month, not an average one.
  4. Tell callers what you need to: Texas is generally treated as a one-party consent state for recording calls, but rules differ for callers in other states, so check with your advisor if you record calls.
